question: Can the proposed BN254 v2 profile derive and pin 130 distinct canonical G1 generators with an explicitly encoded role, index and domain using gnark-crypto HashToG1?
designDecision: Replace the experimental EXP-03 generator derivation only if the candidate produces reproducible vectors, passes canonical/on-curve/non-identity/distinctness checks, and can be independently checked from pinned inputs and dependency version.
scope: Design-stage parameter derivation feasibility. No range-proof fixture, transcript, full verifier, PoC operation or formal-proof completion is claimed.

encoding.messageFormat: ASCII ECU || one byte 0x02 || one byte role || uint32 big-endian index
encoding.indices: 0 for each base; 0 through 63 for each vector

method: Pin Go module version and checksum and record the source hash of the derivation program.
Derive 130 G1 points with HashToG1 using the fixed DST and message encoding.
Check each point is canonical, on BN254 G1, non-identity, and pairwise distinct; record ordered SHA-256 digest and a compact vector file.
Rerun the generator in a fresh process and compare the output digest.

decision.pass: Retain HashToG1 as the v2 generator candidate and proceed to transcript and range-proof interoperability checks; no cryptographic adoption yet.
decision.fail: Reject this encoding or implementation and inspect the cause before selecting another profile.
